page.overview:
What is Li Jing?

Li Jing (李景) descends from Chen Baxian from the paternal side, similar to Li Shimin. Chen Baxian named one of his biological sons Li, and one of his great-great grandsons would eventually father Li Jing. During the Tang dynasty, Li Jing gave credit for most of his career to having descended from Chen Baxian.
